_formato: Library of transport data, per species and background gas (key ESPECIE em FUNDO, that is SPECIES in BACKGROUND, with ZDPlasKin names in upper case).
The fields are those of the transporte.json of a case (mobilidade, difusao, perda_na_parede, atomos_do_fundo, fonte); the mass comes from the formula.
ferramentas/caso.py transport copies from here into the transporte.json of the case whatever is missing there.

AR em AR.fonte: self-diffusion of Ar, 17e-6 m2/s at 1 atm and 273 K (DK of termico.f90 with fundo, no primary source recorded); used only with --free-gas; since 11/11/2026 no longer equal to that of Ar* (ERROS.md A8)

AR* em AR.fonte: diffusion: N D = 1.7e18 cm-1 s-1 of Ar(1s5) at room temperature, Ellis and Twiddy 1969, J. Phys. B 2, 1366 (doi 10.1088/0022-3700/2/12/317), D0 at 1 atm and 300 K; exponent 1.9 kept, without source; corrected 11/11/2026 (ERROS.md A8): before, 17e-6 m2/s at 273 K, the N2-N2 of Capitelli et al. 2000, table 6.2, about three times the measurement; loss of every metastable that reaches the wall, as in the Fortran code

AR^+ em AR.fonte: Golyatina and Maiorov, Plasma Phys. Rep. 43, 75 (2017), at 300 K; Ellis et al. 1976 measure K0 = 1.53

AR2^+ em AR.fonte: Phys. Rev. 160, 130 (1967), authors not recorded in the project; no high-field data

N^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N2^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 203, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N3^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 204, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 7%; above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N4^+ em N2.fonte: Ellis, Pai, McDaniel, Mason and Viehland, At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 17, 177 (1976), p. 205, experimental data at 300 K; error up to 3%; measured only up to 40 Td (N4+ dissociates above); above the last measured E/N, tail K ~ (E/N)^(-1/2), an estimate (decision of the authors, 18/10/2026)

N2(A) em N2.fonte: diffusion: N2(A)-N2, 0.179 cm2/s at 1 atm and 273 K with beta 1.90, Capitelli, Ferreira, Gordiets and Osipov 2000, Plasma Kinetics in Atmospheric Gases, eq. 6.7 and table 6.2 (p. 97), ref. [6] of the table (Zipf 1963; Haydon et al. 1996; Fewell and Haydon 1997); corrected 11/11/2026 (ERROS.md A2): before, 0.202 cm2/s at 300 K of Planet. Space Sci. 1967 (doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4), which is not the measurement the table cites; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(B) em N2.fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: N2(A)-N2, 0.179 cm2/s at 1 atm and 273 K with beta 1.90, Capitelli, Ferreira, Gordiets and Osipov 2000, Plasma Kinetics in Atmospheric Gases, eq. 6.7 and table 6.2 (p. 97), ref. [6] of the table (Zipf 1963; Haydon et al. 1996; Fewell and Haydon 1997); corrected 11/11/2026 (ERROS.md A2): before, 0.202 cm2/s at 300 K of Planet. Space Sci. 1967 (doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4), which is not the measurement the table cites; wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2(A') em N2.fonte: assumed equal to N2(A): short radiative lifetime, transport matters little; diffusion: N2(A)-N2, 0.179 cm2/s at 1 atm and 273 K with beta 1.90, Capitelli, Ferreira, Gordiets and Osipov 2000, Plasma Kinetics in Atmospheric Gases, eq. 6.7 and table 6.2 (p. 97), ref. [6] of the table (Zipf 1963; Haydon et al. 1996; Fewell and Haydon 1997); corrected 11/11/2026 (ERROS.md A2): before, 0.202 cm2/s at 300 K of Planet. Space Sci. 1967 (doi 10.1016/0032-0633(67)90041-4), which is not the measurement the table cites; wall loss 1e-3 as in Capitelli et al. 2000, p. 233 (N2-O2 low pressure discharge model; p. 196 gives <= 1e-2 measured on glass); corrected 11/11/2026 (ERROS.md N9): before, 1 assumed equal to N2(A), without source

N(2D) em N2.fonte: diffusion: N(2D)-N2, 0.227 cm2/s at 273 K and 1 atm, beta 1.50, Capitelli, Ferreira, Gordiets and Osipov 2000, Plasma Kinetics in Atmospheric Gases, eq. 6.7 and table 6.2 (p. 97); wall loss 1 assumed (de-excitation)

N2 em N2.fonte: self-diffusion N2-N2, 0.17 cm2/s at 1 atm and 273 K with beta 1.90, Capitelli, Ferreira, Gordiets and Osipov 2000, Plasma Kinetics in Atmospheric Gases, eq. 6.7 and table 6.2 (p. 97); also used for N2(v); used for the background only with --free-gas; corrected 11/11/2026 (ERROS.md A1, A2): before, taken equal to the measured 0.202 cm2/s of N2(A) at 300 K

N2(V1) em N2+H2.fonte: diffusion by kinetic theory (Cantera 3.2, GRI-Mech 3.0 transport parameters), trace in N2:H2 1:1, 1/D = sum x_j/D_kj; exponent fitted from 300 to 1000 K (as N2); wall loss: Sun et al. 2022, supplement, Table S1 (from Hong et al. 2017); diffusion taken equal to that of N2
